verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a public API for driving LightSprint programmatically. The cited material covers adjacent features only: Slack/Linear/Jira task creation, MCP connectors to outside services, and bring-your-own model API keys. Probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs and llms.txt all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
